ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the oath by the night in Surah Al-Layl?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this oath by the enveloping night (Yaghsha) highlights the transient nature of worldly darkness, serving as a metaphor for the spiritual state of humanity before divine guidance. It establishes the cosmic backdrop for the moral dichotomy presented in the surah, where the 'righteous' (Aqtab) and 'wicked' (Aqtab) are distinguished by their alignment with divine will, a theme central to the concept of Fitrah and the role of the Ahl al-Bayt as guides.
